Sorry if that’s a lot! I just want to make sure everything’s okay.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or

- confirm the **storage size** of the tablet you ordered

I don’t have the order ID with me right now, sorry about that. I hope that’s okay. 

By the way, thanks for helping me out. I don’t get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.

Please reply with **one** of those order IDs, and I’ll check:

Also, about setting your daughter’s address as your default: I can do that, but I’ll need her exact address and **your explicit confirmation (yes)** before I make any address changes.

Thanks for checking! I’m asking about order #W1588712. That’s the one I sent to my daughter.

And sure, I can give you her address so you can set it as my default. Her address is 1842 W Addison St, Chicago, IL 60613. Please go ahead and make that my default address—yes, I confirm.

By the way, I really appreciate you helping me with all this. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses.
